pr.title: git: handle SSH keyboard-interactive auth in source control GUI (#276…
pr.body:
Previously, push/pull operations requiring keyboard-interactive SSH auth (e.g. YubiKey OTP, TOTP, PIV PIN) always failed with "Permission denied (keyboard-interactive)", but using the integrated terminal prompts for user interaction.

Main causes:
- Git subprocesses are spawned with stdin set to 'ignore', so SSH has no TTY to issue interactive prompts on.
- `SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force` redirects all SSH prompts through VS Code's askpass IPC helper, but `handleSSHAskpass()` only handled two cases: **passphrase** and **host authenticity**, and fell through unconditionally into the authenticity block for any other prompt, causing crashes or empty responses for keyboard-interactive challenges.

Fixed handleSSHAskpass() to cover three cases:
1. Passphrase — unchanged.
2. Host authenticity — added protection to prevent argv out-of-bounds access on unrecognised prompts.
3. Added Keyboard-interactive — reconstructs the full prompt text from argv and forwards it to the user via an InputBox. Touch/presence prompts (FIDO2 security key confirmation) are detected by pattern and handled by showing an informational notification and returning an empty response, since SSH drives the key interaction itself and expects no typed input.

This PR would close #276691

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

> [!NOTE]
> Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review.

Adds support for additional SSH askpass flows by handling SSH keyboard-interactive prompts and scoping the authenticity prompt handling more explicitly.

**Changes:**
- Extend SSH askpass support to include keyboard-interactive prompts in addition to passphrase and authenticity.
- Gate authenticity parsing/QuickPick behind an explicit `/authenticity/i` check.
- Add special-case handling for “touch/presence” security key prompts.
